gotchas: The document states a default MODBUS ID of 1 only for MODBUS TCP (port 502, DHCP). It gives NO default slave ID for the serial interface. Emodbus_id lives at 0xE019 with range 1-247 and no stated factory value. Do not assume 1 on serial.

MODBUS TCP and the Ethernet port exist on TS-MPPT-60 only. EIA-485 is also 60-only. TS-MPPT-30 and TS-MPPT-45 are MeterBus + RS-232 only — the Quebec retailer's two models are exactly the serial-only ones.

Nothing can be read without first reading 0x0000-0x0003. Unlike EPEver, scales are not constants — they are per-unit values the controller reports, and every value in the map is expressed relative to them.
0x003A power_out is the charger's output into the battery; 0x003B power_in is array input. They are different numbers and neither can go negative, so neither expresses a bank being discharged.
0x0024 T_rts reads 0x80 when the remote temperature probe is disconnected.
unmappedReports: V_PU hi/lo and I_PU hi/lo (0x0000-0x0003) — not readings, but a driver MUST read them first; every voltage and current is n·V_PU·2^-15 / n·I_PU·2^-15 and power is n·V_PU·I_PU·2^-17, T_hs heatsink temperature (0x0023) — distinct from ambient; `temperature` is the only near match and it means something else, Ahc_r / Ahc_t amp-hours charged, resettable and total (0x0034-0x0037) — `consumed-amp-hours` is discharge, there is no charged-Ah kind, kwhc_r / kwhc_t (0x0038, 0x0039) — arguably pv-energy-total, but the register is energy INTO the battery, not out of the array, hourmeter (0x002A/0x002B) — `uptime` is a link/session metric, not a lifetime hour counter, vb_ref target regulation voltage (0x0033) — the setpoint the charger is aiming at; no setpoint metric exists, sweep_vmp / sweep_voc / sweep_Pin_max (0x003C-0x003E) — array sweep results, no MPPT-specific kinds, fault.all (0x002C) and alarm_HI/LO (0x002E/0x002F) bitfields — no fault or alarm metric kind at all, dip.all DIP switch positions (0x0030) and led.state (0x0031), vb_min/vb_max and the whole daily logger block (0x0040-0x004F, incl. time in absorption/float/equalize), state-of-charge — this controller does not report it in any register
